svg.aria-label: What ./build.sh all does: pinned sources are fetched once, four build steps turn them into imx-boot.bin, kernel.tar.gz and rootfs.tar, and the image step assembles them, without root, into sdcard.img with the bootloader at 32 KiB and an ext4 partition at 8 MiB, which ./build.sh flash writes to an SD card.
svg.text: Pinned sources in, one flashable SD card image out. Every box maps to a command you can run on its own, or print with --dry-run.
filesystem from a plain directory, so no
loop devices, no mount, no sudo.
Boot ROM reads 32 KiB · U-Boot saves its environment at 7 MiB · U-Boot loads the kernel from /boot on p1 · Linux mounts p1 as /
Re-runs skip what is done: an unchanged ./build.sh all takes ~30 s; the first run ~25 min (12 cores).
